reason: Tab stop 46 does jump 88px up, from the last segment of the spend bar in the Budget spend summary card to View all in the Review required card beside it. criterionAnalysis: 2.4.3 Focus Order: focus moves through the left card's controls, then the right card's controls, and each card's stops stay together, so meaning and operability are preserved. 1.3.2 Meaningful Sequence: the DOM order matches the visual card-by-card reading order. The upward move comes from the two cards' different layout, not from content read out of order. No other A or AA criterion covers it.

reason: The tabs are plain divs with no role, no name and no tabindex: focus() on one returns false, Enter and Space do nothing, and the ax probes show role generic with an empty name on all three sampled states. On cards.team-members the sidebar Team Spend link reaches the other tab, and the invoicing tabs only switch a preview, but the finding covers cards.team-spend too.

The input carries autocomplete="garbage", but it is the Search by name or email box in the team members table, not a field that collects the user's own information. It has a visible label of Search team members and the ax probe exposes textbox with that name.
